# gDRimport

Package for handling import of dose-response data

# Website

A package website is available under [this
link](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/).

# Package index

## Load files

- [`enhance_raw_edited_EnVision_df()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/enhance_raw_edited_EnVision_df.md)
  : Enhance raw edited EnVision data.table
- [`get_EnVision_properties()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/get_EnVision_properties.md)
  : Get properties of EnVision data
- [`get_df_from_raw_edited_EnVision_df()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/get_df_from_raw_edited_EnVision_df.md)
  : Get final results (as a data.table) from raw edited EnVision
  data.table
- [`get_df_from_raw_unedited_EnVision_df()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/get_df_from_raw_unedited_EnVision_df.md)
  : Get final results (as a data.table) from raw unedited EnVision
  data.table
- [`get_excel_sheet_names()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/get_excel_sheet_names.md)
  : get Excel sheets names for a charvec of files for non-Excel files
  return 0
- [`get_plate_info_from_template_xlsx()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/get_plate_info_from_template_xlsx.md)
  : Get plate info from template xlsx
- [`load_data()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_data.md)
  : Load data
- [`load_manifest()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_manifest.md)
  : Load manifest
- [`load_results()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_results.md)
  : Load results
- [`load_results_EnVision()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_results_EnVision.md)
  : Load EnVision results from xlsx
- [`load_results_EnVision_new()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_results_EnVision_new.md)
  : Load results from EnVision_new (CSV and XLSX)
- [`load_results_Incucyte()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_results_Incucyte.md)
  : Load incucyte results from plain text
- [`load_results_Tecan()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_results_Tecan.md)
  : Load tecan results from xlsx
- [`load_results_tsv()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_results_tsv.md)
  : Load results from tsv
- [`load_templates()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_templates.md)
  : Load templates
- [`load_templates_tsv()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_templates_tsv.md)
  : Load templates from tsv
- [`load_templates_xlsx()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/load_templates_xlsx.md)
  : Load templates from xlsx
- [`read_EnVision_delim()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_EnVision_delim.md)
  : Read EnVision delimited text files
- [`read_EnVision_xlsx()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_EnVision_xlsx.md)
  : Read in single xlsx data from EnVision
- [`read_in_EnVision_file()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_in_EnVision_file.md)
  : Read EnVision file
- [`read_in_manifest_file()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_in_manifest_file.md)
  : read manifest files
- [`read_in_result_files()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_in_result_files.md)
  : Read in results files
- [`read_in_results_Tecan()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_in_results_Tecan.md)
  : read in Tecan data
- [`read_in_template_sheet_xlsx()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_in_template_sheet_xlsx.md)
  : Read in data from xlsx template sheet
- [`read_in_template_xlsx()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_in_template_xlsx.md)
  : Read in xlsx template files
- [`read_in_tsv_template_files()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_in_tsv_template_files.md)
  : read in tsv template files
- [`validate_template_xlsx()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/validate_template_xlsx.md)
  : Validate template xlsx data

## Pset conversion

- [`convert_MAE_to_PSet()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/convert_MAE_to_PSet.md)
  : Convert MultiAssayExperiment to TreatmentResponseExperiment
- [`convert_pset_to_df()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/convert_pset_to_df.md)
  : Convert a PharmacoSet to a data.table that is prepare for input into
  gDR pipeline
- [`getPSet()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/getPSet.md)
  : Get PharmacoSet
- [`setEnvForPSet()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/setEnvForPSet.md)
  : Adjust environment variables to meet gDR standards

## PRISM conversion

- [`convert_LEVEL5_prism_to_gDR_input()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/convert_LEVEL5_prism_to_gDR_input.md)
  : Load, convert and process the level 5 PRISM data into a gDR input
- [`convert_LEVEL6_prism_to_gDR_input()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/convert_LEVEL6_prism_to_gDR_input.md)
  : Load, convert and process the level 6 PRISM data into a gDR input

## Import D300

- [`import_D300()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/import_D300.md)
  : Import D300
- [`parse_D300_xml()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/parse_D300_xml.md)
  : Parse D300
- [`save_drug_info_per_well()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/save_drug_info_per_well.md)
  : for each drug create a Gnumber and Concentration information for
  each well

## Input data validation/correction

- [`are_template_sheets_valid()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/are_template_sheets_valid.md)
  : are template sheet valid?
- [`check_metadata_against_spaces()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/check_metadata_against_spaces.md)
  : Check metadata against spaces
- [`check_metadata_field_names()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/check_metadata_field_names.md)
  : Check metadata field names
- [`check_metadata_headers()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/check_metadata_headers.md)
  : Check whether metadata headers are correct and make fixes if needed
- [`check_metadata_names()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/check_metadata_names.md)
  : check_metadata_names
- [`check_metadata_req_col_names()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/check_metadata_req_col_names.md)
  : Check metadata for required column names
- [`correct_template_sheets()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/correct_template_sheets.md)
  : Correct names of the template sheets (if required)
- [`.check_against_single_template_sheet()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/dot-check_against_single_template_sheet.md)
  : Evaluate if template file with single sheet is present, if the name
  of the sheet is correct and if it can be fixed
- [`fix_typos_with_reference()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/fix_typos_with_reference.md)
  : Fix typos using reference data
- [`get_exception_data()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/get_exception_data.md)
  : get exception data
- [`get_expected_template_sheets()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/get_expected_template_sheets.md)
  : Get names of the sheets expected in templates xlsx
- [`get_xl_sheets()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/get_xl_sheets.md)
  : Get Excel sheets
- [`mgrepl()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/mgrepl.md)
  : grep wrapper to support multiple patterns

## Utils

- [`detect_file_format()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/detect_file_format.md)
  : Detect format of results data
- [`is_readable_v()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/is_readable_v.md)
  : is_readable_v Check if all paths in vector are readable
- [`read_excel_to_dt()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_excel_to_dt.md)
  : Read excel file and transorm it into data.table object
- [`read_ref_data()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/read_ref_data.md)
  : read_ref_data
- [`standardize_record_values()`](https://gdrplatform.github.io/gDRimport/reference/standardize_record_values.md)
  : standardize_record_values
